events.title: Major Update: Daydream Endgame, Save Protection & QoL
events.summary: 1. Added the final Daydream difficulty, improved progression between difficulties after a first full clear, and completed Daydream boss-key icons and late-game key visuals. 2. Added level 120–150 and fixed level 150 equipment crafting bands. Adjusted late-tier sacrifice costs, with T13 costing 1 billion gold per use. 3. Fixed synergy-adjusted stat-stack caps and shared primary/secondary keyword rules so the intended bonuses apply correctly. 4. Healing-over-time no longer has a per-tick HP percen

events.title: Demo Update: Inventory, Stats & Codex Improvements
events.summary: 1. Added bag sorting, optional free slot arrangement, and a fixed first warehouse page. Fixed equipment retrieval, unequipping by dragging, and empty-slot compaction. 2. Added stat source and passive requirement details. Fixed initial stats panel layout and flickering after kills. 3. Added live skill cooldown indicators and cast animations. Clicking the large portrait now plays an attack animation and sounds, without affecting combat. 4. Fixed floating tooltips being clipped outside the desktop

events.title: Demo Update: Fonts & Workshop Improvements
events.summary: 1. Added a smooth font option in Settings; you can switch back to pixel fonts anytime. 2. Improved talent name layouts and fixed lock and keyword markers. 3. Improved auto-fill when switching to fusion, hatching, or another crafting source. Closing the workshop now clears staged inputs and releases reserved items. 4. Fixed repeated material clicks switching tabs or clearing crafting and alchemy inputs. 5. Improved Chinese text wrapping and unsocketing hints. 6. Added innate affix ranges and effe

events.title: Demo Update: Shields, Storage & Desktop Improvements
events.summary: 1. Vigor now grants an opening shield, with a new blue shield bar. 2. Added one-click storage organization and category pages. Fixed full-storage issues with benching Spirits, swapping breeding parents, and Codex rewards. 3. Improved six-position layouts, auto-docking, and window positions after restarting.
